title: 医用生体工学
subtitle: Bioengineering
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn the structure of organisms and biological functions. (2) Learn about medical equipment. (3) Learn about medical materials.
advice: This is a basic course in bioengineering. We will cover the following topics: 1. Role and position of bioengineering in society 2. Importance of bioengineering 3. Basic of anatomy and physiology 4. Instrumentation for the human body 5. Design and function in organisms 6. Living tissues and histological features 7. Joint lubrication mechanism 8. Nano therapeutic engineering and regenerative medicine 9. Biomaterials 10. Innovation in human health
books: Textbooks: (in Japanese) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to be have completed Basic Biology
